purpose: Restore durable awareness of the user-provided Moses trilogy and Unhindered manuscripts that were brought into the Prose Project before AGLO became the first fully admitted real-book qualification subject.
forensic_finding: The manuscript files were not deleted. They remained in ChatGPT Library, but the live Prose repository state stopped carrying an explicit portfolio/custody record for them. AGLO then became the only manuscript with a full real-book qualification state chain, making the earlier books appear to have disappeared from the project.

authority_rules: Library custody is not the same as canonical manuscript authority.
A CLEAN filename does not prove canonical version status.
NON-AUTHORITATIVE REVIEW COPY may be used only for bounded developmental/diagnostic evidence and never as canon or stable identity authority.
CANONICAL MASTERED v2 is a strong manuscript-internal authority signal, but Prose admission still requires exact source digest/custody binding.
EDITOR-READY is a maturity state, not automatically a canon declaration.
No manuscript may be modified, published, or used to overwrite another version by this custody record.
No raw manuscript prose is persisted in GitHub by this portfolio record.
portfolio_recovery_result: The Moses trilogy and Unhindered books are restored as first-class private Prose Project manuscript assets with their different authority states preserved instead of being silently collapsed into AGLO or Candidate-002.
